title: Residue line of the actual normalized smooth integral exceptional unit
statement: Fix the purity datum P [def-pur-conventions] and a finite extension E of Q_l. Let g:X -> Y be separated and of finite type between finite-type schemes over the fixed field, let j:Xi -> X be open and closed, and let c compactify g. Fix a normalized coefficient comparison record R at E [def-pur-clopen-exceptional-all-coefficients]. Assume g composed with j is smooth of pure relative dimension d. Let U be the integral coefficient unit [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. There is an etale sheaf L of O_E/pi-modules on Xi, etale locally free of rank one, such that the first scalar reduction of (R.integralI U).obj is isomorphic to the intrinsic comparison pullback of L placed in degree -2d, i.e. single(L)[2d] [lem-pur-complete-residue-line-inverse]. This asserts only the residue presentation, for arbitrary finite E; it asserts neither integral finite Tor amplitude, a tensor inverse, rational invertibility nor common-stage invertibility. It includes the empty Xi and d=0, and specifies no trivialization.

source.place: First paragraph, shifted rank-one smooth dualizing object; integral and field extension in Step 4 of finite-clopen inverse assembly

proof.text: Compare the integralI right adjoint with the normalized integral exceptional construction for c.precomp j.left, using the uniqueness of right adjoints to the same specified integral compact-support functor. Apply scalar reduction to its value at the integral unit. Use the actual reduction-system and finite evaluation comparison of that normalized construction, and the canonical reduction of the integral coefficient unit, to identify this residue with the intrinsic finite exceptional image of the finite unit. This uses the normalized strict reduction system, never an arbitrary tower with the same limit.

proof.text: Finite type over the fixed field gives Noetherianity and invertibility of the coefficient prime. Apply smooth tensor duality at the residue ring: the etale dualizing complex is L[2d] for an etale locally free line L. The finite adjunction and etale/pro-etale comparison unit identify its intrinsic image with the finite exceptional value of the unit. Exact comparison commutes with the degree-zero embedding and shifts. Compose with the first comparison. On the empty scheme these are the unique zero-object comparisons; d=0 uses the unshifted line.

theorem smooth_clopen_residue_line
    (Xi : Over (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Xi.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Xi.left ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (c : Compactification g) (j : Xi ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j.left] [IsClosedImmersion j.left]
    (R : ClopenExceptionalCoefficientComparison P E X Y Xi g c j)
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j.left ≫ g)] :
    let U : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory P.coefficients.l E Y.left :=
      ⟨integralConstantCoefficientObject P.coefficients.l E Y.left,
        (integralConstantCoefficient_constructible P.coefficients.l E Y.left
          P.field P.coefficients.different).2.1⟩
    ∃ L : Sheaf Xi.left.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u}
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing P.coefficients.l E 1))),
      completeResidueEtaleLine Xi.left (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing P.coefficients.l E 1) L ∧
      Nonempty ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension P.coefficients.l E Xi.left 0).obj
          (R.integralI.obj U).obj ≅
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((completeResidueEtalePullback P.coefficients.l E Xi.left 0).obj L))⟦2 * (d : ℤ)⟧)
